summary: Tested newly added TR/EN language toggle button in Playspintech topbar. The button itself works end-to-end: it renders in the topbar next to theme-toggle on every authenticated page (desktop+mobile), flips its own label TR<->EN, writes to localStorage 'pst_lang', and correctly restores on reload. Theme-toggle regression is clean, no JS/console errors, no overlap on 1920x800 or 375x800. HOWEVER — the actual translation of strings does NOT happen. Layout.jsx destructures {lang, toggle} from useI18n() but never calls the t() function, so 100% of sidebar nav labels, user-footer text, topbar 'Bagli', 'Profil & Sifre', 'Cikis Yap', 'Admin Paneli', 'Bir site secin' block remain hardcoded Turkish literals in JSX. Login.jsx does not import useI18n at all, contradicting the review request which stated 'Login.jsx should be fully translated (uses useI18n)'. The i18n dictionary in /app/frontend/src/lib/i18n.jsx has all required keys — they are just never consumed.

ui_bugs.issue: Nav labels are hardcoded Turkish strings ('Panel', 'Gunluk Giris', 'Kasalar', 'Manueller', 'Giderler', 'Transferler', 'Raporlar', 'Devirler', 'Ayarlar'). Empirical test: after clicking lang-toggle to EN, all labels remain in Turkish. Expected: 'Dashboard', 'Daily Entry', 'Cash Registers', 'Manuals', 'Expenses', 'Transfers', 'Reports', 'Rollovers', 'Settings'.
'Admin Paneli' hardcoded; does not switch to 'Admin Panel' in EN.
'Playspintech Admin' (role label line 195), 'Profil & Sifre' (line 204), 'Cikis Yap' (line 207) all hardcoded — none translate to EN.
'Bagli' hardcoded — does not switch to 'Connected'. Dictionary key topbar.connected exists but is not used.
'Incelenen Site', 'Site secin' placeholder, and 'Admin Paneline Don' button (line 138) hardcoded — do not switch.
'Bir site secin', long help text, and 'Admin Paneline Git' button hardcoded.

Login page does not import or call useI18n at all. All strings hardcoded Turkish: 'Hesabiniza girin' (h2), 'Giris' (kicker), 'E-posta', 'Sifre' labels, 'Giris Yap' button, 'Bugunku modul', 'Sitelerin finansal kontrolu tek panelde', brand paragraph, 'Hesap olusturma yetkisi...' hint, and toast messages ('E-posta ve sifre gerekli', 'Hos geldin', 'Giris basarisiz'). Review request explicitly said this page should already be translated via useI18n — it is not.
'Menuyu kapat', 'Menuyu ac', 'Dil degistir', 'Tema degistir' aria-labels hardcoded Turkish. Minor accessibility inconsistency when lang=en.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking lang-toggle correctly updates the useI18n context (lang state flips, localStorage updates, button label changes) but Layout.jsx does not consume the t() function to render translated text. Root cause: destructuring `const { lang, toggle: toggleLang } = useI18n();` on line 52 omits `t`. Fix: add `t` to destructure and replace hardcoded strings with `t('nav.dashboard')` etc. Same fix needed in Login.jsx (add `const { t } = useI18n();`).

verifications_passed.theme_toggle_independent: PASS - html.dark class toggles cleanly, no state loss on either toggle when clicked in sequence
verifications_passed.no_js_console_errors: PASS - clean console across all 11 pages while lang=en
verifications_passed.mobile_topbar_layout: PASS - drawer-open (x=16-52), lang-toggle (x=280-319), theme-toggle (x=327-359) — no overlap on 375px wide viewport
verifications_passed.site_switcher_still_works: PASS - dropdown opens, site selection navigates to site pages

action_items: CRITICAL (E1): In /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx line 52, add `t` to the useI18n destructure: `const { lang, t, toggle: toggleLang } = useI18n();`

CRITICAL (E1): In /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx, replace all hardcoded label strings with t() calls: siteNav labels (use nav.dashboard/nav.daily/nav.kasalar/nav.krediler/nav.giderler/nav.transferler/nav.raporlar/nav.devirler/nav.ayarlar), adminNav label (nav.admin), 'Admin Paneli' text (line 175), 'Site Paneline Git' (line 181), user footer 'Playspintech Admin' (line 195 -> profile.admin), 'Profil & Sifre' (line 204 -> nav.profil), 'Cikis Yap' (line 207 -> nav.logout), 'Bagli' (line 252 -> topbar.connected), 'Incelenen Site' (line 128 -> sidebar.viewedSite), 'Site secin' placeholder (line 131 -> sidebar.selectSite), 'Admin Paneline Don' (line 138 -> nav.backToAdmin), and the no-site-selected block (lines 261-263 -> topbar.selectSitePrompt / topbar.selectSiteText / topbar.goToAdmin).

CRITICAL (E1): In /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx, import and use useI18n. Replace hardcoded strings with keys already present in the dictionary: h2 -> login.title, kicker -> login.subtitle, labels -> login.email/login.password, button -> login.submit, hint -> login.hint, brand kicker -> login.today, brand h1 lines -> login.brandLine1/2/3, brand paragraph -> login.brandDesc, toasts -> login.errRequired / login.welcome / login.errFailed.
LOW (E1, optional): Translate aria-labels on drawer-open/drawer-close/lang-toggle/theme-toggle for full a11y consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx:52 — useI18n() destructure is missing `t`. This single omission is the root cause of the entire feature being non-functional beyond the toggle button itself.

Layout.jsx:31-45 — siteNav and adminNav are module-level constants with `label:` populated by Turkish string literals. Because these arrays are defined outside the component, they cannot use t() directly; refactor to compute inside the component or store i18n keys in `labelKey` and resolve via t(item.labelKey) at render time.
Login.jsx — useI18n is not imported. Review request claim 'should be fully translated (uses useI18n)' is inaccurate; page still uses raw Turkish literals and hardcoded toast strings.
i18n.jsx:167 — t() implementation is correct with proper fallback chain (current lang -> tr -> fallback -> key). Dictionary is comprehensive. Nothing to fix in this file.
Positive: localStorage persistence, hydration on mount, and document.documentElement.lang attribute update are implemented correctly.
Positive: lang-toggle button visual styling matches theme-toggle (same h-8 border rounded-sm, tasteful font-data uppercase pill) — no design regression.

success_rate.frontend: 45% — toggle mechanics (button, persistence, theme coexistence, mobile layout, no-crash regression across 11 pages) all pass, but the actual translation behavior for sidebar/topbar/login is non-functional because t() is never wired into JSX

seed_data_creation: None. Only browser-side interaction, no DB writes beyond login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After E1 fixes the two files (Layout.jsx and Login.jsx), retest by: (1) login as admin, (2) confirm sidebar starts Turkish ('Panel', 'Gunluk Giris', 'Kasalar'...), (3) click lang-toggle, (4) verify sidebar switches to English ('Dashboard', 'Daily Entry', 'Cash Registers'...), (5) verify 'Bagli' -> 'Connected', 'Cikis Yap' -> 'Log Out', 'Profil & Sifre' -> 'Profile & Password' in the sidebar user footer, (6) hard reload (F5) — sidebar should remain English, (7) go to /login (log out first), toggle to EN via a mechanism (there is no toggle on /login — verify that if pst_lang='en' in localStorage, the login page renders in English: 'Sign in to your account', 'Email', 'Password', 'Sign In').
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: E1 completed step 1 (build the toggle infrastructure — i18n context, dictionary, localStorage, button UI) but did not complete step 2 (consume `t()` in the consumer components). Specifically, /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx line 52 destructures only `{ lang, toggle: toggleLang }` from useI18n() and never destructures `t`. All ~15 UI text nodes in Layout.jsx are raw Turkish string literals in JSX. Additionally, Login.jsx does not even import useI18n. Reproduction: login as admin, observe sidebar labels; click [data-testid='lang-toggle']; observe button label flip to 'EN' but every other label remains Turkish. Mitigation: two-file edit — see action_items above.
